full_prompt_en: A square illustrated collage divides into twelve close figure portraits arranged in four columns and three rows, alternating warm orange and cool teal backgrounds. Thin straight seams separate the panels, but the faces sit close to those borders and make the whole sheet feel crowded. In the top row, four middle-aged or older men occupy shoulder-up views. Two have bald heads, while the others have short dark hair; one at the far right has a heavy mustache and a hand lifted near his chin. Their jackets, collared shirts, and guarded expressions vary subtly within a common dark palette. The middle row continues with a stern balding man at left and a gray-bearded man beside him. At the center-right, a younger dark-haired man leans forward with a narrow intense look and an open rust-red shirt. At the far right, a woman in a red sleeveless garment turns partly away and looks over her shoulder. Along the bottom, another dark-haired woman in red holds a small pale glass near the left edge. Beside her, an older bald man faces the viewer in a loose collared shirt. A heavier man in a dark hat and suit fills the third panel, and the far-right man in a teal jacket touches his face with one finger. The backgrounds suggest shallow interiors through repeated blocky lines and doorlike shapes, but no panel opens into a full room. Light falls broadly from the front and slightly above, giving cheeks, foreheads, and hands warm highlights while strong ink-like shadows settle around eyes and collars. The surfaces have fine painted grain and lightly broken contours rather than smooth photo realism. Orange, brick red, turquoise, and deep charcoal move across the grid in alternating bands. There is no readable title or caption. The overall composition makes individual attitudes readable inside a disciplined modular structure, using color shifts and compressed portraits for a tense ensemble mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形插画拼贴被分成十二幅近景人物肖像，按四列三行排列，背景在暖橙与冷青蓝之间交替。细直线分隔各格，但面孔靠近边线，使整张图显得拥挤。最上排，四名中年或年长男子以肩部以上的近景出现。两人秃顶，另两人留短深发；最右者有浓重胡须，一只手举在下巴附近。他们的外套、翻领衬衫和戒备神情在共同的深色调里微妙变化。中排左侧是一名神色严厉、头顶稀发的男子，旁边是一位灰须男子。右中位置，一名较年轻的深发男子身体前倾，目光狭窄而强烈，穿敞开的锈红衬衫。最右侧，一名穿红色无袖衣服的女子半转身，回头望向画外。底排左侧，另一名穿红色的深发女子在画面边缘附近拿着一只小浅色玻璃杯。旁边，一名年长秃顶男子穿松开的翻领衬衫，面向观者。第三格，一名戴深色帽子和穿西装的壮硕男子占满画格；最右侧穿青蓝外套的男子用一根手指触碰脸部。背景通过重复的块状线条与门框般形状暗示浅层室内，但没有任何一格展开成完整房间。光从正面略偏上方宽阔照来，让面颊、额头和手承接暖色亮部，眼周与衣领处则沉入有墨线感的强阴影。表面带细密绘画颗粒与轻微断续轮廓，而非平滑摄影写实。橙色、砖红、绿松石蓝与深炭色在方格间交替移动。没有可读的标题或说明。整体构图在严整模块结构中保持各人的态度清楚可辨，以色彩变化和压缩肖像形成紧张的群像气氛。
style_prompt_en: The illustrated collage uses a rigid modular grid to hold many tightly cropped, expressive forms. Thin dividers establish order, while neighboring panels alternate warm ochre, rust red, teal, and blue-green backgrounds. Within each cell, front-facing and angled shapes are modeled with fine grain, short broken strokes, and dark ink-like contour accents. Broad frontal light catches raised surfaces, while deep shadows under small projections create quick dimensional cues. Background structures remain shallow and geometric so the focal forms carry most of the detail. Repetition across equal-sized compartments builds rhythm; small variations in pose, value, and color keep the sequence lively. The warm-cool switching draws the eye across rows without requiring a single central focal point. The overall effect is dense and characterful, balancing a disciplined layout with rough painted texture and individual shifts in expression.
style_prompt_zh: 这种插画拼贴使用严整的模块方格容纳许多紧密裁切、富有表情的形体。细分隔线建立秩序，相邻画格的背景则在暖赭黄、锈红、青蓝与蓝绿之间交替。每格内部，正面或倾斜的形体由细颗粒、短促断续笔痕和深墨线般的轮廓重音塑造。宽阔正面光照亮凸起表面，小突起下方的深影迅速提示体积。背景结构保持浅而几何化，使焦点形体承担大部分细节。同尺寸格子的重复建立节奏，姿态、明度与颜色的小变化让序列保持活力。冷暖切换引导目光横穿各排，而不要求单一中央焦点。整体效果密集且有个性，在严谨布局、粗糙绘画肌理与个别表情变化之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A twelve-panel grid of expressive figures in a warm and teal illustrated collage
theme_zh: 暖色与青蓝色插画拼贴中的十二格人物表情图
name: The Sopranos
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
